👑 Über uns

Welcome to Gold Price Germany, the premier specialized platform for tracking live gold, silver, and precious metal prices in real-time across the Federal Republic of Germany.

Our Mission & Vision

We aim to empower consumers and investors in Germany—especially expatriate communities—with precise, direct feeds from the Frankfurt exchange, enabling transparent comparisons with local bullion dealers to avoid excessive markups.

Transparency & Legal Compliance

We provide vital clarification on legal and tax aspects, including the 100% VAT exemption (MwSt) on investment bullion (24k) and personal income tax exemption on capital gains when holding bullion for over 12 months.
